selection_rules: High-yield Step 1 mechanism or interpretation objective
No proprietary wording, option structure, explanation, screenshot, or media may be reused
Full 7,937-stem similarity screen remains mandatory before any import approval

objectives.subtopic: Right ventricular outflow obstruction and hypercyanotic spells
objectives.learning_objective: Explain why squatting relieves a Tetralogy of Fallot spell by increasing systemic vascular resistance and reducing right-to-left shunting.

objectives.subtopic: Diastolic left atrial-left ventricular gradient and pulmonary venous hypertension
objectives.learning_objective: Connect rheumatic mitral stenosis to a diastolic transmitral gradient, left atrial enlargement, atrial fibrillation risk, and pulmonary venous hypertension.

objectives.subtopic: Tissue transglutaminase, deamidated gliadin, and HLA-DQ2/DQ8
objectives.learning_objective: Explain celiac disease through tissue-transglutaminase-mediated gliadin deamidation, HLA-DQ2/DQ8 presentation, and T-cell-mediated villous injury.

objectives.subtopic: ATP7B dysfunction, impaired biliary copper excretion, and low ceruloplasmin
objectives.learning_objective: Identify Wilson disease and connect ATP7B dysfunction to impaired biliary copper excretion, low ceruloplasmin, urinary copper elevation, hepatic injury, and neurologic disease.

objectives.subtopic: Synovial pannus, RANKL signaling, and marginal erosions
objectives.learning_objective: Connect rheumatoid pannus and inflammatory cytokines to RANKL-dependent osteoclast activation and marginal erosions.

objectives.subtopic: Immune-complex deposition and complement consumption
objectives.learning_objective: Recognize lupus nephritis as a type III hypersensitivity process characterized by immune-complex deposition, complement activation, and granular immunofluorescence.

objectives.subtopic: Autoreactive lymphocytes and CNS oligodendrocyte injury
objectives.learning_objective: Differentiate CNS from peripheral demyelination by linking optic neuritis, internuclear ophthalmoplegia, periventricular plaques, and oligoclonal bands to oligodendrocyte injury.

objectives.subtopic: Accessory atrioventricular pathway and ventricular preexcitation
objectives.learning_objective: Explain the short PR interval and delta wave in WPW as early ventricular activation through an accessory atrioventricular pathway.

objectives.subtopic: Venous outflow obstruction and hemorrhagic infarction
objectives.learning_objective: Recognize testicular torsion as a vascular emergency in which venous outflow is lost before arterial inflow, producing hemorrhagic infarction.

objectives.subtopic: PTH-induced osteoblast RANKL and osteoclast activation
objectives.learning_objective: Explain PTH-mediated bone resorption through osteoblast RANKL expression and osteoclast differentiation rather than direct PTH action on osteoclasts.

objectives.subtopic: Cortisol excess, 11beta-HSD2 saturation, and mineralocorticoid receptor activation
objectives.learning_objective: Connect severe cortisol excess to saturation of 11beta-HSD2, renal mineralocorticoid receptor activation, hypertension, and hypokalemia.

objectives.subtopic: Autoantibodies to alpha-3 type IV collagen in glomerular and alveolar basement membranes
objectives.learning_objective: Identify anti-GBM disease by pulmonary hemorrhage, crescentic nephritis, linear IgG, and antibodies to the alpha-3 chain of type IV collagen.

objectives.subtopic: PR3-ANCA-associated necrotizing granulomatous inflammation
objectives.learning_objective: Distinguish GPA from other vasculitides by its upper-airway disease, cavitary lung nodules, pauci-immune glomerulonephritis, PR3-ANCA, and necrotizing granulomas.

objectives.subtopic: Ectopic gastric mucosa and adjacent ileal ulceration
objectives.learning_objective: Explain painless pediatric lower gastrointestinal bleeding from a Meckel diverticulum through ectopic gastric acid secretion and adjacent ileal ulceration.

objectives.subtopic: Molecular mimicry and acute inflammatory peripheral demyelination
objectives.learning_objective: Recognize Guillain-Barre syndrome and explain its postinfectious autoimmune pathogenesis through molecular mimicry directed at peripheral nerve gangliosides.

objectives.subtopic: CGG repeat expansion, methylation, and FMR1 silencing
objectives.learning_objective: Connect the Fragile X phenotype to a maternally expanded CGG repeat, promoter methylation, FMR1 silencing, and loss of FMRP.

objectives.subtopic: Reduced delayed rectifier potassium current and prolonged repolarization
objectives.learning_objective: Explain congenital long QT syndrome through reduced phase-3 potassium current, prolonged repolarization, early afterdepolarizations, and torsades risk.

objectives.subtopic: TSC1/TSC2 loss and constitutive mTOR signaling
objectives.learning_objective: Connect TSC1/TSC2 loss to Rheb activation, constitutive mTORC1 signaling, and multisystem hamartomas.

objectives.subtopic: Tropheryma whipplei-laden PAS-positive macrophages
objectives.learning_objective: Recognize Whipple disease from migratory arthralgia, malabsorption, and PAS-positive acid-fast-negative macrophages containing Tropheryma whipplei.

objectives.subtopic: Molecular mimicry between streptococcal M protein and host tissues
objectives.learning_objective: Explain acute rheumatic fever as poststreptococcal molecular mimicry involving cross-reactive antibodies and T cells against heart, joint, skin, and neural tissues.
